source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD13A3.061 monthly vegetation indices, tile h19v04 (LP DAAC)
label: Vegetation index on cropland (NDVI)

confidence.note: Averaged over cropland pixels only (≥ 50 % ESA WorldCover 2021 'cropland' inside the pixel). Not available for Vâlcea county and the few communes outside the downloaded WorldCover tiles (south of 45 °N / west of 21 °E). Good / marginal-quality pixels only; months with < 30 % clear pixels dropped. Mixes all crops: a greenness signal, not a yield estimate.
